STAGE 1 - ORIENTATION
GOAL: find what inputs actually exist in this workspace before designing a metric.
READ: directory listing of the round agent folder.
OBSERVED: (to be filled by following read).
REASONING: need to know the SID table schema, the frozen Issue #126 reference format, and whether training pairs are exposed, so the formula is implementable as stated.
OPEN: pick a construction that is not a rearrangement of tightness/margin/likelihood/coverage on single-anchor inputs.

STAGE 2 - INPUT PROBE
GOAL: locate the SID table and Issue #126 reference files.
READ: attempted to read the agent working directory.
OBSERVED: read permission denied on /fs04/.../agents/metric_ideation_3; the task statement is the only source of schema information available.
REASONING: the contract explicitly names three optional inputs (exported SID table, frozen reference source/target reps, training split), so I will define the metric against those names generically and let the evaluator bind them. This does not weaken the proposal: every quantity below is specified as an array operation on a named array.
OPEN: finalise a hyperbolic construction that uses the FULL training history as the query barycentre AND the FULL negative distribution as a temperatured expected-rank, which is what the round summary says is unexplored.

STAGE 3 - DESIGN CHECK
GOAL: make sure the chosen construction is not a rearrangement of the refuted families and is implementable exactly.
READ: none (no filesystem access); reasoning against the round summary.
OBSERVED / DECISION:
- Rejected: cell tightness, covering radius, Voronoi margin, path likelihood, bucket reach, any level-2/3 prefix score. All refuted.
- Chosen: the query point is the hyperbolic Frechet (Karcher) barycentre of the query's WHOLE remaining training history, on the target side, instead of a single source anchor; the contrast is a temperatured EXPECTED RANK over all n_1 level-1 cell prototypes instead of a mean over ten sampled negatives; and the number is a log-lift over the exact size-matched permutation null rho_0=(n_1-1)/2, which follows from sigma(z)+sigma(-z)=1 and makes collapse (n_1=2,3,12) capped at log((n_1+1)/2).
- Curvature c=1 enters through exp_0(v/tau), Mobius addition + 2*artanh, and two Karcher barycentre families (history points and cell prototypes), 20 fixed iterations.
- Constants: c=1, 20 iterations, radius cap 1-1/N, T = median own-cell distance (reference's own distance scale), all stated; nothing fitted to the 97 recalls.
- Cost: no N x N matrix; O(sum_i |H_i|^2 * 20 * d) barycentre work plus |E'| * n_1 Poincare distances. A few seconds to ~20 s at 24587 items and 256 codes.
OPEN: only the final write-up; formula is settled.

STAGE 3 - DESIGN CHECK
GOAL: confirm the construction is not a rearrangement of the refuted families.
DECISION: rejected cell tightness, covering radius, Voronoi margin, path likelihood, bucket reach, any level-2/3 prefix score (all refuted). Chosen: query point = hyperbolic Frechet (Karcher) barycentre of the query's WHOLE remaining training history on the target side (not a single source anchor); contrast = temperatured EXPECTED RANK over all n_1 level-1 cell prototypes (not ten sampled negatives averaged); number = log-lift over the exact size-matched permutation null rho_0=(n_1-1)/2 (from sigma(z)+sigma(-z)=1), so collapse is capped at ln((n_1+1)/2).
Constants: c=1, 20 Karcher iterations, radius cap 1-1/N, T = median own-cell distance. Nothing fitted to the 97 recalls.
Cost: no N x N matrix; O(sum_i |H_i|^2 * 20 * d) + |E'|*n_1 Poincare distances; seconds to ~20 s.
OPEN: final write-up only.

STAGE 4 - FINAL ANSWER (condensed record; full text delivered in the reply)
METRIC hyp_hist_bary_rank_lift_l1.
INPUTS: SID table level-1 digit pi(a); frozen reference source/target vectors with temperature tau; TRAIN pairs. Nothing else.
FORMULA: c=1 Poincare ball. emb(v)=r(v)v/||v||, r=min(tanh(||v||/2tau),1-1/N); d_H=2 artanh(||(-x)(+)y||); Karcher means (20 fixed exp/log iterations) give cell prototypes m_k and, for each pair (i,j), the leave-one-out history barycentre h_ij over the query's other training targets. delta_ij(k)=d_H(h_ij,m_k); T=median delta_ij(pi(j)); rho_ij=sum_{k!=pi(j)} sigma((delta_ij(pi(j))-delta_ij(k))/T). HBRL=mean over pairs of ln((n_1+1)/(2(rho_ij+1))). Random partition -> 0; max ln((n_1+1)/2).
GEOMETRY: exp map in, Mobius+artanh distances, two Karcher barycentre families; Euclidean c->0 version differs.
WHY: level-1 token must be a low-entropy function of the query; the history barycentre is the minimum-variance hyperbolic summary on a channel Q_H never uses; the expected rank over all cells is a top-10 surrogate for Recall@10; the exact size-matched null makes collapse (n_1=2,3,12) score at most 0.405/0.693/1.870.
COMPUTE: ~1e10 flops at 24587 items, 256 codes, 2.5e5 pairs; chunked, <1 min.
RISKS: shared source/target space required; small-tau saturation compresses rho toward rho_0; heavy-user histories dominate; level 2+ ignored.
FAILURE MODE: worst on a level-1 digit that is an independent hash of the item index (rho -> rho_0, HBRL -> 0); n_1=1 returns 0.
END METRIC
